verses.html: 35 While Jesus was teaching in the temple courts, He asked, “How can the scribes say that the Christ is the Son of David?
verses.text: 35 While Jesus was teaching in the temple courts, He asked, “How can the scribes say that the Christ is the Son of David?

verses.html: 36 Speaking by the Holy Spirit, David himself declared: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand until I put Your enemies under Your feet.”’
verses.text: 36 Speaking by the Holy Spirit, David himself declared: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand until I put Your enemies under Your feet.”’

verses.html: 37 David himself calls Him ‘Lord.’ So how can He be David’s son?” And the large crowd listened to Him with delight.
verses.text: 37 David himself calls Him ‘Lord.’ So how can He be David’s son?” And the large crowd listened to Him with delight.

verses.html: 35 And answering, Jesus, teaching in the temple, said, “How do the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?
verses.text: 35 And answering, Jesus, teaching in the temple, said, “How do the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?

verses.html: 36 David himself, in the Holy Spirit, said, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I put your enemies under your feet.”’
verses.text: 36 David himself, in the Holy Spirit, said, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I put your enemies under your feet.”’

verses.html: 37 David himself calls him ‘Lord,’ and how is he his son?” And a large crowd was listening to him gladly.
verses.text: 37 David himself calls him ‘Lord,’ and how is he his son?” And a large crowd was listening to him gladly.

verses.html: 35 Then, while Jesus was instructing people in the temple area, he asked a question of his own. He said, “Does it make sense when the teachers of the Jewish law claim that the Messiah must be a descendant of King David?
verses.text: 35 Then, while Jesus was instructing people in the temple area, he asked a question of his own. He said, “Does it make sense when the teachers of the Jewish law claim that the Messiah must be a descendant of King David?

verses.html: 36 {I ask that because} the Holy Spirit caused King David to write that the Lord God said to David’s Lord, ‘Rule with me while I defeat all of your enemies!’
verses.text: 36 {I ask that because} the Holy Spirit caused King David to write that the Lord God said to David’s Lord, ‘Rule with me while I defeat all of your enemies!’

verses.html: 37 So, King David called the Messiah ‘Lord.’ {However, people do not describe their descendants as their lords.} Therefore, how is it possible for the Messiah to be a descendant of King David?” A very large group of people enjoyed listening to Jesus {say these things}.
verses.text: 37 So, King David called the Messiah ‘Lord.’ {However, people do not describe their descendants as their lords.} Therefore, how is it possible for the Messiah to be a descendant of King David?” A very large group of people enjoyed listening to Jesus {say these things}.

verses.html: 35 Jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, “How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?
verses.text: 35 Jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, “How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?

verses.html: 36 For David himself said in the Holy Spirit, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’
verses.text: 36 For David himself said in the Holy Spirit, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’

verses.html: 37 Therefore David himself calls him Lord, so how can he be his son?” The common people heard him gladly.
